title: MEIKO — A Clever Idea〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here with the message cards I made!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I made some too!
Here you are, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Oh, you guys made more cards?!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We also made some. These are for you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, for me?! Thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Then, here's one from me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like Miku and Rin are exchanging cards again.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's sort of become their favorite activity recently after Emu came over and showed everyone how to make them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And it looks like somewhere along the way, the plushies learned how to make their own cards too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but I can see why they like doing this so much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Writing your feelings down on cards made with care, giving and getting them from each other... It makes everything feel kinder somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's hard not to smile after seeing the recipient look so happy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO! Why don't we do a show that centers around exchanging cards?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We can't let the times pass us by. And I'm sure we'll be able to put on a wonderful show that everyone is going to love!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... Yes, I do like your idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't we see what the others think?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A show about exchanging cards?! That sounds like a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, exchanging cards is always so exciting! It's bound to be a super fun show☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
Then, let's start discussing what the actual story is going to be about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, it's brainstorming time☆

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If we're going to use message cards, then the story probably needs to involve telling others how you feel, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, what if we had the protagonist make one?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... That's certainly the most logical choice, but I feel like we need a little bit more...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, what if the protagonist were a card?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If the protagonist were a card?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The person writing the message possesses such powerful feelings that they end up bringing the card to life!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's an amazing idea...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, wait a second...
If it comes to life, then doesn't that mean it's gonna have its own feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need to think carefully about how that part will work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, what if we did this?
It's drawn to the person's feelings, and from there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, we're set in terms of where we're going to go with this story!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While writing her message, the girl's feelings manifest in the form of a fairy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And this fairy embarks upon an adventure to deliver her message to its rightful recipient. That makes sense to me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you all for helping turn my idea into this wonderful story!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now we still need to work on turning this into an actual show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We came up with so many different ideas, so pulling them all together tidily might be a bit tricky.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, what are you all doing gathered up like this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Tsukasa...! Your timing couldn't have been better! Do you happen to be free right now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I have time.
We just finished practice over at Morinomiya, so I decided to come over here to take a break.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you! The thing is, for our next show...
